patch_description: The annealing loop changes the soft-min width at every iteration, but previously compared a candidate evaluated at the new width against an incumbent score retained from the preceding width. This makes acceptance decisions inconsistent: narrowing the soft-min alone changes the objective even when the point set has not changed. Re-evaluating the incumbent at the current width produces a valid deterministic annealing comparison and lets late iterations genuinely optimize the near-minimum triangle constraints.
